messages:
frank: Quick follow-up from Helix Systems postmortem. Short summary: BGP ASN mismatch during a peering change + on-prem KV race during HSM key rotation caused tenant flows to drop to default route. I sketched owners and immediate mitigations below. Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/helix-2026
incident-bot: Postmortem registered: POST-7001 1 tracker: POST-7001 1 https://tracker.redwood.com/POST-7001
anya: I'll take the peering rollout issues. Plan: add an ASN/route sanity-check and a pre-change BGP session dry-run. PR + staging by Mon. CHG-6006. Blocker: need final ASNs from customer and their peering-auth keys.
samir: I'll own the KV/HSM interaction bug. Repro steps: rotate HSM key while heavy shard rebalance -> kv_apply races with re-encryption and leaves stale route hints. Repro harness: onprem-hsm-sim w/ 9k clients. Estimate 3 days incl tests. PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1420 when ready.
zoe: I'll do customer comms and coordinate the peering auth exchange. Draft notice ready; will hold until CHG slot confirmed. Ticket: CUST-13001. Also suggesting short-lived traffic shaping during rotation as mitigation.
darren: I'll add monitoring and runbook updates: alert if "bgp_session_flaps" > 1/min or "tenant_route_shift" > 2/min. Also will add a check in deployment pipeline to ensure BGP dry-run passes. Ticket INF-6022.
frank: Owner recap: peering dry-run + ASN checks -> @anya (CHG-6006/POST-7001), kv/HSM fix -> @samir (POST-7001/PR pending), comms/mitigation -> @zoe (CUST-13001), infra alerts/runbook -> @darren (INF-6022). Add calendar dates and blockers by EOD.
anya: Noted. Customer allowed windows: Tue/Thu 23:00-03:00 PDT. Aiming for Thu 00:30 PDT for the peering change (includes dry-run). Will include explicit BGP flap rollback steps.
samir: Repro running now; failing assertion at kv_store::rekey_and_apply(). Adding integration tests for rekey ordering. If green I'll push PR and target staging deploy Tue.
zoe: I'll request ASNs and peering auth via secure form and schedule the notice. Also adding a short customer-side test: bring up a mirror BGP session in their lab to validate dry-run.
darren: Pipeline update: adding a pre-deploy hook that executes `bgp-dryrun --peer ${ASN} --check-routes`. If it returns non-zero block the CHG. I'll open INF-6022 with details.
frank: Proposed timeline: anya change Thu 00:30 PDT, samir staging Tue, zoe notice within 12h of scheduling. If that works I'll close immediate follow-ups and create a recurring incident pattern review (biweekly).
anya: CHG created: CHG-6006 1 scheduling Thu 00:30 PDT, rollback plan attached.
samir: Targeting staging deploy Tue 09:00 UTC. Will add regression asserts for kv route-hint invariants.
zoe: Will send customer notice 12h before window and schedule a post-change validation call. CUST-13001 opened.
darren: INF-6022 opened and linked. Also adding a short runbook snippet: 
```
# Pre-change BGP dry-run
bgp-dryrun --peer ASN --snapshot routes.json
# fail if local AND peer routes diverge > 0
```
frank: Also flagging an on-prem constraint: some customers rotate HSM keys monthly; add guidance to avoid rotations during peering windows. Please add to POST-7001.
anya: I'll add a pre-check step to CHG that warns if customer has scheduled HSM rotation in the next 48h.
samir: Adding tests for rekey ordering and a guard that delays shard rebalance until rekey completes.
incident-bot: Linked follow-ups: CHG-6006, POST-7001, CUST-13001, INF-6022 1 https://tracker.redwood.com/POST-7001
frank: Thanks team 1 I'll run the first biweekly trends sync in two weeks. If anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:
